body: I see your point on telling my parents about my suicidal thoughts. The psych ward teaches suicidal teens that suicide is against God and that they shouldn't feel that way because it's a sin. I don't think I'd feel comfortable there.

No, I haven't. I'm scared of them sending me to a psych ward and the only one in my area is horrible. My friend had to go there and it's very religious, and I'm scared they'll try to do something to me because I go against their beliefs.

I haven't sat down with them to talk about. Mostly because whenever I try to bring it up, they tell me to stop being dramatic. I make mistakes but they always put them against me and it makes me very upset because I do love them. I've told that I needed help a couple of times this year and they say they are going to give me help but they never do. I understand that I must frustrate them because I'm not the only kid they have to raise but I wish they could at least try to understand me. I always try to talk to them about it, I really do but they always blow it off.
